description: The settings window, by the label SETTINGS_WINDOW in src/settings_window.rs; rename both together (docs/decisions/0028-settings-window.md). Grants six bridge commands, one permission each: dispatch and query (the bridge admits only SetUiSettings and GetSettings from this window), open_stream, subscribe_app and ack for its channel and the app feed, and display_info. Beside them only the two window commands of Tauri's drag script, DRAG_PERMISSIONS in src/window_frame.rs; capabilities/frame.json adds the caption buttons' on Windows and Linux. Never subscribe, unsubscribe, answer_permission, pick_folder, open_external, open_file, reveal or open_settings: every permission widens what script in the page can reach.
